form:FormGroup.label: Max Wait For Data
form:FormGroup.helpText: The longest that incomplete data is held back waiting for the rest of it to arrive; complete data does not wait. After this, whatever has arrived is published. Enter 1 to 9999 and choose Minutes to Months; if retention is enabled it must be shorter than Retain For. Default is 12 hours.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number and unit; shorter than Retain For if retention is on. Default is 12 hours.

form:FormGroup.label: Bucket Granularity
form:FormGroup.helpText: How the queryable store is split up by time: HOUR, DAY or WEEK. Default is DAY.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: HOUR, DAY or WEEK. Default is DAY.
